summary: Serve the existing panel from the MCP gateway root and keep browser API calls on the selected pilot

delivery.outcome: Opening the delivered 8084 URL returns the existing Taskand panel; browser API requests target that origin and 8090 compatibility remains.
nonGoals: New tool admission or changes to API authorization

architecture.decision: Serve only the fixed bundled index.html path for GET / and /index.html. Use the current browser origin except the established standalone 8090 frontend. Reuse minimal root-serving behavior from preserved PR38 with bounded error handling and query-safe logging.

evidence: real HTTP root and browser API-origin smoke checks

architecture.rollback: Restart the previous immutable 8084 release, preserving request history.

validation.evidence: Actual gateway HTTP root aliases, API isolation and unchanged authorization; browser origin checks and deployed MCP canary.
